title: Agent Chat message text is not selectable (1276 user-select:none over-applies to rendered text)
description:
REPRO: Open the Agent Chat panel, send/receive a message, then try to select & copy the message text (LLM response or your own user message). Selection does not work — nothing highlights, copy yields nothing.

ROOT CAUSE: Task 1276 (mobile 'tap selects whole app' fix) added a global `user-select:none` (+ `-webkit-user-select:none`, `-webkit-touch-callout:none`) on <body> at apps/desktop/src/styles.css:32-35, with an opt-in allowlist re-enabling `user-select:text` ONLY for `input, textarea, select, [contenteditable]` at apps/desktop/src/styles.css:45-53. Agent Chat MESSAGES are rendered as plain non-input elements (div/span/pre) so they inherit the body `user-select:none` and are NOT in the allowlist. Specifically the transcript region and its message bubbles in packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/AgentChatPanel.tsx: transcript container style at AgentChatPanel.tsx:597 (applied to the <div data-testid=agent-transcript> at AgentChatPanel.tsx:339), user message bubble style `userBubble` at :631 (rendered :407), assistant text `assistantText` at :647 (rendered :460), `reasoning` at :654, and tool `toolPre` at :733 — none set userSelect. The 1276 fix over-applied: it suppressed selection on genuine rendered text the user legitimately wants to copy.

EXPECTED: Chat message text (assistant responses, user messages, reasoning, tool args/result) is selectable and copyable with mouse/keyboard.
ACTUAL: All chat message text is unselectable because it inherits the global user-select:none and is not in the editable allowlist.

FIX DIRECTION: Add `user-select:text` (+ `-webkit-user-select:text`, and `-webkit-touch-callout:default` to match the existing allowlist entries) to the chat transcript/message region so messages are selectable/copyable, while leaving 1276's global suppression intact for the rest of the non-editable authoring chrome. Cleanest options: (a) set userSelect:'text' on the `transcript` style object in AgentChatPanel.tsx:597 so all descendant message text inherits it, or (b) add a selector to the allowlist in styles.css scoped to the chat transcript (e.g. via [data-testid=agent-transcript]). Prefer scoping to the transcript container so chrome buttons (settings toggle, send/stop) stay non-selectable.

RELATED (out of scope for this task, but note): the Output/trace panel has the same defect — packages/authoring-ui/src/OutputPanel.tsx:76 message scroll region (data-testid=output-panel-messages) renders trace lines in <div> (:98) with no userSelect, so trace output is also unselectable/uncopyable for the same reason. The ActionsPanel code editor is unaffected (textarea is in the allowlist + sets userSelect:text explicitly at ActionsPanel.tsx:779). Consider a follow-up to make Output trace lines selectable too.

REF: task 1276.

FIX (done 2026-06-19): Re-enabled selection on the Agent Chat transcript scoped to its container, leaving 1276 global suppression intact for all other chrome.
- apps/desktop/src/styles.css: added an allowlist rule `[data-testid="agent-transcript"], [data-testid="agent-transcript"] *` setting user-select:text + -webkit-user-select:text + -webkit-touch-callout:default (mirrors the input/textarea allowlist). Scoped so only transcript message text (assistant/user bodies, reasoning, tool args/result/error) is selectable.
- packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/AgentChatPanel.tsx: set userSelect:'text'/WebkitUserSelect:'text' on the `transcript` style object (belt-and-suspenders; descendants inherit).
CHROME PROTECTED: settings toggle (:294) and composer send/stop buttons (:360-397) are siblings OUTSIDE the <div data-testid=agent-transcript> (opens :338, closes :357), so they still inherit body user-select:none from 1276.
VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build green; pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run => 56 files, 765/765 passed.
